about: List prices in US dollars per million tokens for the Voice cleanup models, read by the Mac and the Android app. Model names match case-insensitively. A model running on the user's own machine costs $0 without an entry here, and any other model missing here counts as unpriced. Checked 2026-11-09; Celeris added from https://docs.celeris.ai/pricing on 2026-11-10.
